metadata.description: Student and post-study visa rules for Bangladeshi CS/AI/ML students
metadata.note: Rules accurate as of June 2026. Immigration rules change frequently. Always verify with official government sources.

studentVisa.financialRequirement: Tuition + CAD 10,000 per year for living costs
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Open Work Permit if enrolled in 16+ month program at DLI
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 20 hours/week during semester, full-time during breaks
studentVisa.rejectionRiskBangladesh: High due to ties to home country requirement and financial documentation scrutiny
studentVisa.tips: Strong bank statements for last 6 months, Letter of Explanation, proof of strong ties to Bangladesh critical

postStudyVisa.duration: Up to 3 years for programs 2+ years
postStudyVisa.eligiblePrograms: Full-time programs at Designated Learning Institutions (DLI)
postStudyVisa.notes: PGWP duration tied to program length. Changes proposed post-2024 to restrict to high-demand NOC codes. Monitor IRCC announcements.
postStudyVisa.difficultyLevel: Low if enrolled in eligible DLI program

workVisa.visaName: Temporary Foreign Worker Program / International Mobility Program

studentVisa.financialRequirement: AUD 24,505 for first year (2025 rate) plus tuition
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Dependent can apply as secondary applicant
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 48 hours per fortnight during study, unlimited during breaks
studentVisa.tips: Genuine Temporary Entrant (GTE) requirement critical. Strong academic record and clear study plan needed.

postStudyVisa.duration: 2-6 years depending on study level and location

streams.requirement: Skills and qualification in occupation on skilled list

streams.duration: 2 years bachelor, 3 years masters, 4 years PhD

streams.requirement: STEM degree from regional institution, 485 holder

workVisa.notes: Replaced TSS visa November 2024. Core Skills stream includes ICT roles.

studentVisa.financialRequirement: EUR 11,208 per year in blocked account (Sperrkonto) as of 2025
studentVisa.englishRequirement: IELTS 6.0-6.5 or German B2/C1 depending on program language
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Spouse can apply for dependent visa with limited work rights initially
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 120 full days or 240 half days per year
studentVisa.tips: Blocked account mandatory. University admission letter required. Financial proof very strict.

postStudyVisa.visaName: Job Seeker Visa (post-study residence permit for job search)
postStudyVisa.duration: 18 months job search period after graduation
postStudyVisa.notes: After finding job can convert to skilled worker residence permit. No quota or lottery.

pathways: EU Blue Card (salary threshold EUR 43,800 for shortage occupations incl. IT 2024)
Chancenkarte (Opportunity Card) - points-based without job offer
workVisa.notes: EU Blue Card is fastest PR pathway. Chancenkarte allows job search without employment

studentVisa.financialRequirement: EUR 7,000 for first year plus tuition
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Spouse can apply for joining visa with Stamp 3 (limited work rights)
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 20 hours/week during term, 40 hours during holiday periods
studentVisa.tips: Strong financial documentation. Genuine student intent critical. Accommodation proof often required.

postStudyVisa.visaName: Third Level Graduate Programme (Stay Back Option)
postStudyVisa.eligiblePrograms: Full-time degree programs at Irish HEIs
postStudyVisa.notes: Can apply for Critical Skills Employment Permit after finding qualifying job during stay-back period

workVisa.salaryThreshold: EUR 32,000 for critical skills list occupations (CS/AI included)
workVisa.notes: Critical Skills list includes software engineers, data scientists, AI specialists. Fastest PR route in Ireland.

studentVisa.financialRequirement: EUR 11,400 per year for living costs
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Spouse can join with dependent residence permit, limited work rights
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 16 hours/week or full-time in June, July, August
studentVisa.tips: University acts as sponsor which simplifies process. Financial proof required.

postStudyVisa.notes: Can work full time during orientation year. After finding job can apply for Highly Skilled Migrant (Kennismigrant) permit.

workVisa.notes: 30% tax ruling (reduced from 2024 to 30% capped at EUR 233,000 income) still provides tax benefit

studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Accompanying family members residence permit available
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: No formal limit for non-EU students with valid permit
studentVisa.tips: Proof of funds, admission letter, and accommodation evidence required

postStudyVisa.visaName: Residence Permit for Job Seeking after Studies

workVisa.requirements: Job offer, union-standard salary, employer SWEA notification
workVisa.notes: Sweden does not use points system for work permits. Union involvement in salary verification is unique feature.

studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Family member residence permit available
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 25 hours/week during study, full-time during holidays
studentVisa.tips: Financial proof and admission letter mandatory. Finnish tuition for non-EU students (introduced 2017) is now EUR 8,000-15,000/year for most programs.

workVisa.requirements: Job offer with at least EUR 3,000/month gross salary

studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Spouse can apply for family reunification with right to work
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 20 hours/week during semester, full-time June-August

postStudyVisa.notes: Relatively short job-seeking period. Aim to secure job before graduation if possible.

studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Family members can apply for accompanying permit
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 20 hours/week

workVisa.requirements: Relevant qualifications and job offer or concrete job offer

studentVisa.englishRequirement: IELTS 6.5 for English programs, German/French for local programs
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Spouse can apply for dependent permit
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 15 hours/week
studentVisa.notes: Non-EU student quota per canton. ETH Zurich and EPFL outside cantonal quota for research positions.

postStudyVisa.notes: Short window. Highly competitive. Non-EU quota applies to work permits.

workVisa.notes: Non-EU workers subject to annual quota (approximately 4,500 B permits per year total for non-EU). Competition extremely high.

studentVisa.englishRequirement: IELTS 6.0 for English programs, German B2 for German programs
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Family reunification permit available after 3 months
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 20 hours/week

studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Family reunification possible
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 20 hours/week

workVisa.notes: Combines work and residence permit. Regional authority competence (Flanders, Wallonia, Brussels).

studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Partner eligible for open work visa if student enrolled in 2+ year degree
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 20 hours/week during term, full-time during holidays

postStudyVisa.duration: Up to 3 years depending on study level and location

workVisa.visaName: Green List Visa / Skilled Migrant Category
workVisa.notes: Green List Straight to Residence for tech roles. Efficient pathway.

studentVisa.financialRequirement: Full tuition plus USD 12,000-25,000/year cost of attendance proof
studentVisa.englishRequirement: TOEFL 80-100+ or IELTS 6.5-7.0 depending on institution
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: F-2 visa for spouse - NO work rights
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 20 hours/week on-campus only during semester
studentVisa.tips: Strong financial documentation, test scores, statement of purpose critical. Visa interview required at US Embassy Dhaka. Appointment wait times can be 6-12 months.

postStudyVisa.duration: 12 months OPT + 24 months STEM OPT extension = 36 months total
postStudyVisa.pathwayToPR: Only via H-1B lottery or EB sponsorship
postStudyVisa.notes: STEM OPT requires employer with E-Verify enrollment. H-4 EAD for spouse has been subject to political restrictions under current administration.

workVisa.spouseWorkRights: H-4 EAD - currently restricted under 2025 executive orders
workVisa.pathwayToPR: EB-2/EB-3 with employer sponsorship but Bangladeshi nationals face 50-100+ year backlog due to per-country cap
alternativePathways: EB-1A Extraordinary Ability (no per-country wait for approval but still backlogged)
workVisa.notes: Most critical immigration challenge for Bangladeshi students targeting US PR. Per-country cap reform has been debated for years without resolution.

studentVisa.englishRequirement: IELTS 6.5 for English programs or JLPT N2 for Japanese programs
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Dependent visa available, limited work rights (28 hours/week)
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 28 hours/week (資格外活動許可)
studentVisa.tips: Certificate of Eligibility (COE) obtained by university or language school makes process smoother.

postStudyVisa.duration: 12 months (extendable once to 24 months total with legitimate job search evidence)
postStudyVisa.notes: J-Find visa (2023) allows 2-year job search for graduates of top universities globally. Can work part-time during search.

workVisa.requirements: Job offer from Japanese company, relevant degree
workVisa.notes: Highly Skilled Professional (HSP) visa with points system. 70+ points for HSP-1. PR possible in 1 year with 80+ points or 3 years with 70+ points.

studentVisa.financialRequirement: KRW 20,000,000 in bank account or scholarship proof
studentVisa.englishRequirement: IELTS 5.5-6.5 for English programs or TOPIK Level 3+ for Korean programs
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: F-3 dependent visa with limited work rights
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 20 hours/week with permission (알바 가능)

workVisa.notes: For AI, software, and tech occupations. Points-based F-2 visa for skilled professionals.

studentVisa.financialRequirement: Sufficient funds for tuition and living (no fixed minimum stated)
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Dependent Pass possible
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 16 hours/week for full-time students with LOC from ICA

postStudyVisa.notes: No formal post-study job search visa. Must secure employment. Tech.Pass for established tech professionals.

workVisa.notes: Complementarity Assessment Framework (COMPASS) scoring for EP. Points for salary, nationality diversity, education, firm support.

studentVisa.englishRequirement: IELTS 6.0 for English programs or HSK 4+ for Chinese programs
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: S1 dependent visa available
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: Limited, requires separate permit

postStudyVisa.notes: Work permit (外国人工作许可证) required. Separate from residence permit.

workVisa.notes: Type A (high-end), B (professional), C (general). AI professionals can qualify for Type A or B.
workVisa.pathwayToPR: Extremely limited. Permanent Residence (中国绿卡) practically inaccessible.

studentVisa.englishRequirement: IELTS 6.0-6.5 for English programs, DELF B2/C1 for French programs
studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Family visa available for spouses
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: 964 hours/year (approximately 20 hours/week)
studentVisa.tips: Campus France interview required for Bangladeshi applicants (Etudes en France procedure).

workVisa.notes: Efficient pathway for skilled tech workers. No labor market test.

studentVisa.spousePermitIncluded: Dependent visa available if student meets income threshold
studentVisa.workRightsDuringStudy: Part-time permitted with NOC from institution

postStudyVisa.notes: No formal PR pathway. Golden Visa is not PR.

goldenVisa.eligibility: Monthly salary AED 30,000+ for specialists, researchers, AI professionals

workVisa.notes: Zero income tax. Golden Visa is long-stay renewable visa not equivalent to PR or citizenship.
